known_constraints: Files must exist before they can be renamed
Renaming operations may overwrite existing files if not guarded
Ordering matters when names are derived from existing filenames
Filesystem permissions may block rename operations

common_steps.name: Identify target files
common_steps.description: Select files to be renamed based on location or pattern. No assumptions about naming structure.

common_steps.name: Define naming rule
common_steps.description: Determine how new filenames are derived (e.g., prefix, suffix, replacement). Decision comes from external intent.

common_steps.name: Check for conflicts
common_steps.description: Identify potential filename collisions before applying changes.

common_steps.name: Apply rename operation
common_steps.description: Rename files according to the defined rule.

common_steps.name: Verify results
common_steps.description: Confirm that files were renamed as expected.
